adapter_written_members: One author/operation commitment receipt bounded by four <=32KiB author records plus <=64KiB bundle/<=32KiB review descriptors
One small result receipt; no copied original outer/inner/log bodies

gate_read_derivation.enforcement: Actual pinned gate per-call caps, declared source-total limit and sequential exception stop; not included in entry.IO counter. One oversized/changed file terminates traversal. No automatic retries.

original_outer_report: Full report remains in original operation retained partition, not8MiB adapter metadata. Captured for validation under independent profile receipt_read_bytes and adapter address-space cap.
pre_final_snapshot_limit: Original inner/outer snapshots precede their own final receipt save; do not relabel them complete kernel/resource measurement.

profile.combined_managed_read_ceiling: original operation read_bytes +256MiB adapter reads +128MiB central gate +qualified receipt_read_bytes. These are cumulative managed reads, not disk retention or native/kernel I/O.
profile.combined_retention: original operation retained_bytes +8MiB adapter metadata +current unrelated future reserve; original partitions unchanged.
profile.full_receipt_budget: Independent qualified operation runtime profile; original outer receipt may exceed ordinary metadata cap. No actual selection here.
profile.host_address_space: Adapter soft RLIMIT_AS selected independently; inherited hard cap preserved to permit original child controller cap. Environment/physical capacity remain unqualified.
profile.original_program_resource_limits: Exact future original operation limits and per-phase limits retained; no small proxy defaults.

receipt_reads: Authenticate outer,inner andcontroller metadata plus original combined logs; require receipt_read_bytes >=3*outer_receipt_max_bytes +controller_log_bytes +5EOF sentinel bytes. Full dimension/profile feasibility remains unqualified.
